question: この計画で安全に実行を開始できるか。
description: Reviews a plan before any task starts. The judgment is about readiness to begin, not about code that does not exist yet.
subject: plan
requirements
design

baseline.description: A first plan has nothing to regress against; the judgment is absolute, so this Flow declares no compare-baseline step.

evidence.description: Without the plan there is no subject; the run stops with DETERMINISTIC_UNRUNNABLE.
Absent requirements remove the plan-versus-requirement cross-check; the remaining plan-internal review still runs and the degradation is recorded.
Absent design skips the design cross-check and records the reason.
